metadata.title: Incident Postmortem
metadata.subject: Blameless post-incident narrative for learning and follow-up
metadata.author: PresentationKit

processFlow.title: How the incident unfolded
processFlow.subtitle: A neutral timeline moves from signal through mitigation and learning.
processFlow.caption: The point is learning, not blame.

footprint.title: Impact frame
footprint.subtitle: Separate observed impact, affected paths, dependencies, and recovery status.
footprint.caption: Impact language stays factual and scoped.

architecture.title: Postmortem evidence model
architecture.subtitle: Incident evidence is organized into causes, mitigations, and durable follow-up.

slides.label: 1 / incident context
slides.title: The incident story starts with impact and timeline
slides.headline: A useful postmortem turns a stressful event into shared operational knowledge.
slides.supportingLine: Use a clear sequence to show detection, response, mitigation, explanation, and improvement.
slides.speakerNotes: Start with facts and scope. Avoid blame and avoid overstating certainty.

slides.label: 2 / incident proof
slides.title: Evidence makes the learning defensible
slides.headline: Claims are tied to alerts, logs, changes, and responder notes.
slides.supportingLine: The deck should make it easy to see what is known, what changed, and what will improve.
slides.guardrailLine: Guardrails: focus on systems; evidence before claims; every action has an owner.
slides.speakerNotes: Anchor the postmortem in inspectable evidence and clear follow-up.

slides.label: 3 / incident ambition
slides.title: The dream: incidents improve the system and the team
slides.headline: A postmortem succeeds when it reduces repeat failure and improves response quality.
slides.closingLine: Turn the incident into durable operational learning.
slides.speakerNotes: Close by emphasizing prevention, detection, and shared accountability.
